Fun Facts

  • This page is the 2500th page of this wiki.
  • The Color scheme of this station alludes to Satori Komeiji, a character from Touhou Project.
  • This station began as a node and has been expanded twice.
  • The Los Sengas Coffee of this station was located at the , Concourse. However, it has since been relocated to the , Concourse after its expansion.
  • A set of lavatories existed at the north end of Concourse. However, since the , Part extension, the lavatories have been removed to provide a connection to the Shopping Street.
  • This station is the permanent down direction terminus of . However, the Turn Back Sidings for of this station aren't constructed until the Extension to Stivali Peninsula Station.
  • This station is the first station to have its in-station transit built during an expansion. The in-station transit for this station is not built until the , expansion.
  • Exit E of this station is uni-directional.
  • Prior to the establishment of , Spoilers of its route can be seen at the , Station Control Room of this station.

title: Orama Island
safeHtml:
'''Orama Island''' is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Location

'''Orama Island''' is an octagonal island surrounded by four different islands in the Centopia District. It is sandwiched by Centopia Island to the east, Leben Island to the south, Relish Island to the west and Hakeem Island to the north.

Transport

Railway

Currently, this island does not feature any railway access.

Road

In terms of access roads, this island is connected by road from Hakeem Island to the north, Leben Island to the south and Relish Island to the west. Moreover, the road connection heading towards Centopia Island to the east also features a pedestrian footbridge at the middle of the two ways of the road which leads to Centopia.

In terms of roads within the island, this island features a two-lane dual carriageway ring road at the outskirts of the island, with a roundabout to the east of this ring road and another two-lane dual carriageway cutting through the ring in a diagonal fashion from the northeast to the southwest. The diagonal road also features a single-lane two-way road and yet another east-west oriented two-lane dual carriageway that connects to a roundabout and the ring road to the west respectively, as well as providing potential connection to Relish Island. The roundabout connected to the diagonal road is also connected to the ring road from three sides, with the north side and the south side leading to the Leben Island connection road and the east side leading to the east roundabout of the ring road.

Overall, while the roads on this island are not in a regular grid-like pattern, it forms the outlining shape of a Nazca Railway icon.

Fun Facts

  • The name of this island '''Orama''' is taken from the Greek language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which means "Vision".https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%CF%8C%CF%81%CE%B1%CE%BC%CE%B1</ref>
  • The channel that exists between Centopia Island to the east and this island is 400m wide.
  • As no new stations were involved on this island at the time of NR Headquarters Phase 2 Development, the construction of roads on this island have been sub-contracted.
  • If Aerial Images are captured from above this island, the icon of Nazca Railway could be seen, corresponding to the fact that this island will house the Nazca Railway Headquarters in the future.

Future Development

When the Chinese Name of this island, Vision, is considered, it implies that the Nazca Railway Headquarters may be built on this island in the future.

History

  • October 14 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • November 5 2023: This island completed road pavement.
  • November 19 2023: The road link to Hakeem Island completed construction.
  • November 30 2023: The footbridge to Centopia completed construction.
  • December 2 2023: The road link to Centopia Island completed construction.
  • December 18 2023: The road link to Leben Island completed construction.
